newsitem.title: UK: Qatar Khaleej field starts production-Elf.
newsitem.headline: Qatar Khaleej field starts production-Elf.

text.p: Elf Petroleum Qatar, a unit of Elf Aquitaine, said on Wednesday it has begun producing crude oil at Qatar's offshore al-Khaleej field.
"The initial daily rate of production is 6,000 barrels with a gradual increase planned to reach 30,000 barrels per day (bpd) by year-end," Elf said in a statement.
Elf, which has a 25-year production-sharing agreement with state Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) to develop the field, is operator with a 55-percent stake.
Agip Spa holds the remaining 45 percent.
Al-Khaleej crude oil is piped 42 kms to Halul Island, where it is exported via QCPC's terminal.
Six wells are producing at present, but there are plans for further development after the first phase of production, Elf said.
